en.sayed-ali-raza: I had sent towards him a large army of Muslims.
When he came to know of it he fled away and retreated repenting. They met him on the way when the sun was about to set.
They grappled for a while like nothing.
It was about an hour and then he rescued himself half-dead as he had almost been taken by the neck and only the last breath had remained in him.
In this way, he escaped in a panic.
